The Rays played 162 regular-season games in 2026 and 85 of them (52%) had no run in the first inning, the result an NRFI bet needs. They scored in the first in 32% of their games and allowed a first-inning run in 24%. Everything below is counted from the official line scores through September 27, 2026.

|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|

| Home | 81 | 41 | 40 | 51% |
| Away | 81 | 44 | 37 | 54% |
